meta.title: Internal build
meta.description: Wringy internal build: data read from the database through the API.

banner: 内部版本 · Internal build · Versi dalaman

page.title: Internal build
page.description: This page shows demonstration campaigns read from the database through the API, and the health of the background jobs.

campaigns.title: Demonstration campaigns
campaigns.description: Fixture campaigns read from the database through the API, with the API's read-only account.
campaigns.caption: Demonstration campaigns in the database, most recently updated first
campaigns.emptyDescription: The database holds no fixture campaigns. An operator loads them with pnpm db:seed:fixtures.

workers.title: Background job health
workers.description: Each background worker reports a process heartbeat and a queue round trip. Both are judged on the database clock.
workers.noneDescription: No background worker has written a heartbeat to this database, so its state is unknown. Unknown does not mean zero.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: There is no internal-build page at this address.

notConfigured.title: API not configured
notConfigured.description: The web server has no usable API address, so nothing is read. An operator sets the variables below and restarts it.

apiUnreachable.title: The API could not be reached
apiUnreachable.description: The web server got no answer from the API in time, so nothing is shown. Nothing was changed.

apiUnavailable.title: The database is unavailable
apiUnavailable.description: The API is running but cannot read its database right now, so nothing is shown. Nothing was changed.

unexpected.title: Unexpected answer from the API
unexpected.description: The API answered in a way this page does not recognise, so nothing is shown. Nothing was changed.

signIn.title: Sign in to the internal build
signIn.description: The internal build is for invited testers. Sign in with the Google account whose address is on the tester list.
signIn.returnHint: After signing in you come back to the page you asked for.

cancelled.title: Sign-in cancelled
cancelled.description: You cancelled the sign-in, so nothing changed. You can try again whenever you like.

expired.title: Sign-in expired
expired.description: This sign-in took too long, or its link had already been used. Please start again.

wrong_browser.title: Finish signing in in the same browser
wrong_browser.description: This browser did not start the sign-in, or another sign-in was started in the meantime. Please start again here.

session_ended.title: Your session ended
session_ended.description: Your session ended, so you were signed out. Sign in again to carry on where you were.

signed_out.title: You have signed out
signed_out.description: You signed out of this device. Sign-ins on your other devices are not affected.

signed_out_unconfirmed.title: Signed out of this device
signed_out_unconfirmed.description: This device is signed out. The server could not confirm that it ended the session, so if you are signed in elsewhere, check that device too.

not_allowed.title: This is an internal version
not_allowed.description: This address is not on the tester list for the internal version. Ask the Wringy team to add it if you should have access.

disabled.title: This account is disabled
disabled.description: This account has been disabled, so it cannot be used to sign in. Contact the Wringy team if you think that is a mistake.

unexpected.title: Sign-in did not finish
unexpected.description: Something went wrong and the sign-in did not finish. Nothing was changed. Please try again.

session.otherDevicesNote: Signing out ends this device’s session only; your other devices stay signed in.

probe.title: Session check
probe.description: This reserved command changes nothing. It shows that a command which would change something re-checks that your session is still live before it runs.

results.ok: The session check passed: this session is still live.
results.revoked: This session is no longer live, so the command was refused. Sign in again.
results.unauthenticated: There was no usable session, so the command was refused.
results.unavailable: The session could not be checked just now, so nothing ran. Nothing was changed. Please try again.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Your own account and the organisations you belong to. Open an organisation to work in it; every page checks your membership again.
workspaces.none: You do not belong to any organisation yet. Create one below, or open an invitation link an admin sent you.

create.note: You become the organisation's first admin.

members.title: Members
members.caption: Active members of this organisation, with their role and since when

invite.title: Invitations
invite.description: Invite someone by their email address. You get a link to send them yourself.
invite.signInNote: The person must be able to sign in to this build: their address has to be on the tester list.
invite.lifetime: The link works once, only for that address, and expires after {days} days.
invite.handOver: Wringy does not send the link. You copy it on the next page and send it yourself.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.caption: Invitations from this organisation that have not been accepted or revoked

leave.title: Leave this organisation
leave.description: You lose access to this organisation straight away. An admin can invite you again. The last admin cannot leave.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this organisation
forbidden.description: You are not a member of this organisation, or no longer are. Nothing here was shown or changed.

link.label: Accept link
link.note: Copy this link and send it to {email} yourself. It works once, and only when that address signs in.

noLink.title: The link is no longer shown
noLink.description: The link is shown only right after the invitation is created, in the browser that created it. If it was lost, revoke this invitation and create a new one.

notPending.title: This invitation is not pending
notPending.description: It was accepted or revoked, or you are not an admin of this organisation.

accept.title: Join {org}
accept.description: You were invited to join {org} as {role}.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.description: Ask an admin of {org} to send you a new one.

used.title: This invitation has already been used

mismatch.title: This invitation was sent to a different address
mismatch.description: You are signed in with an account it was not sent to. Sign out, then open the link again and sign in with the address it was sent to.

invalid.title: This invitation link is not valid
invalid.description: It may have been revoked, or the link was not copied completely. Ask the admin who sent it for a new one.

outcomes.created: Organisation created. You are its admin.
outcomes.invited: Invitation created. Copy the link below and send it yourself.
outcomes.revoked: The invitation was revoked. Its link no longer works.
outcomes.member_removed: The member was removed from this organisation.
outcomes.forbidden: You do not have access to that organisation, so nothing was changed.
outcomes.admin_required: Only an admin of this organisation can do that, so nothing was changed. Your role may have changed since the page was loaded.
outcomes.last_admin: An organisation must keep at least one active admin, so nothing was changed. Make another member an admin first.
outcomes.already_member: You are already a member of that organisation. The invitation was closed.
outcomes.pending_exists: An invitation for this address is already pending. Revoke it first to send a new one.
outcomes.invalid_email: That email address could not be used. Check it and try again.
outcomes.not_pending: That invitation is no longer pending, so nothing was changed.
outcomes.not_found: That member or invitation is not in this organisation, so nothing was changed.
outcomes.session_ended: Your session ended, so nothing was changed. Sign in again and retry.
outcomes.unavailable: The database is unavailable right now, so nothing was changed. Please try again.
outcomes.unexpected: Something went wrong and nothing was changed. Please try again.
outcomes.invitation_invalid: That invitation link is not valid, so you were not added. Ask the admin who sent it for a new one.
outcomes.invitation_expired: That invitation has expired, so you were not added. Ask an admin for a new one.
outcomes.invitation_used: That invitation has already been used, so nothing was changed.
outcomes.invitation_mismatch: That invitation was sent to a different address, so you were not added.
